name: trailblazer-jekyll-theme
description: Dev-convenience scripts for the Trailblazer Jekyll theme. The theme itself needs no Node — these wrap the Ruby toolchain so `npm run dev` works for people who live in npm.

scripts.check:css: npx --yes sass@1.77.8 --no-source-map --load-path=_sass --stdin --style=compressed < scripts/css-smoke.scss > /dev/null && echo 'SCSS compiles clean.'
